semantics: dependencies[420Identity] lists REQUIRED runtime/authority dependencies only; OPTIONAL and NOT_APPLICABLE classifications are retained here and are not treated as mandatory runtime gates.

classifications.rationale: ProtocolRegistry discovers/publishes Identity externally; Identity420 does not resolve Registry state at runtime. Registry publication and code-hash provenance remain deployment/integration concerns.

Issuer mutation is governance-controlled through SystemAccess.onlyGovernance and the immutable governanceTimelock. The current canonical Identity contract does not require a second IGovernanceAuthority420 call to preserve that authority boundary.

Identity420 has no canonical local/global pause action classes. Profile/issuer active state is domain lifecycle, not PauseRegistry state. Adding pause semantics would be a protocol behavior change requiring explicit versioned design.
Identity credentials and trust classes do not grant ambient dApp capabilities. Identity mutation authority is controller, issuer-controller, or governance based.
Current Identity v3 defines no SystemSafety action classes and has no custody/value settlement path. Adopting shared safety gating would require an explicit versioned behavior decision.
Identity420 does not implement IGenesisInitializable420. Genesis constructor/immutable/storage materialization is owned by the predeploy pipeline and ID-AUDIT-4/5, not by a runtime shared dependency.

Current Identity has no proxy/migration execution path. Historical identity must remain immutable; future implementation migration/provenance may compose with IMigration420 through an explicit later version.
Current Identity mutations are direct msg.sender transactions and do not accept signed off-chain envelopes or meta-transaction authorization.
There is no signed-envelope/message replay surface in Identity420. Credential IDs are unique on-chain objects; EVM transaction nonces remain outside this shared interface.
Identity420 has no cross-chain signed domain or external message acceptance requiring a runtime chain-context dependency. Deployment/network identity remains a testnet qualification concern.

Identity stores opaque metadataHash/claimHash commitments canonically. External schema/reference validation may compose later, but canonical profile/credential mutation does not require IMetadataCommitment420.

authority_invariants: GovernanceTimelock remains the sole governance mutation authority for issuer configuration.
Profile credentials do not imply CapabilityRegistry authorization.
Optional Registry/metadata/migration integrations may not become Identity state authority.
Identity direct-call mutation paths do not claim SignedEnvelope or ReplayProtection guarantees.
Genesis predeploy materialization remains required even though IGenesisInitializable420 is not a runtime dependency.
